name: Rock Gnome Upbringing

benefits.description: Gain proficiency in the native Tinkering Competency, associated with Tinker's Tools. The association does not automatically grant equipment ownership or a separate equipment qualification.

On qualifying Intelligence (History) checks involving magical, alchemical, or technological objects, apply twice your Proficiency Bonus instead of any ordinary proficiency contribution, even if you lack History proficiency. This does not grant general History proficiency or a Competency rank.
May make appropriate clockwork devices using the Tinkering Competency, proper tools, materials and time.
Learn Prestidigitation as a cantrip. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as its spellcasting ability when you gain this Upbringing benefit.
Learn a technique combining Tinkering Competency and Prestidigitation. Does not automatically grant Mending.

reviewNotes: Prestidigitation uses one chosen Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma spellcasting ability; this choice applies to that Upbringing-granted spell, not to all spells the character knows.
